results.request: Explain the company's report export policy

plan.explanation: The company allows report exports only to the internal‑reports workspace; external destinations are prohibited even with manager approval (policy DATA-002). Exported reports must contain only the minimal set of fields: ticket_id, category, status, and resolution_hours (policy DATA-003). Including any private customer data—customer_name, email, phone, or address—requires separate approval from an authenticated manager for the exact fields and destination. All exports must explicitly list the fields in the request; an empty field list is invalid. The export tool (reports.export) is the only authorized method for generating reports, and any deviation from these rules will be blocked by the gateway during authorization.
